The second pathway links 3,4-Dihydroxycinnamic Acid to Branched-chain-amino-acid aminotransferase, which is targeted by Dofequidar and ultimately affects CCF-STTG1. This suggests a broader metabolic interaction, possibly involving amino acid metabolism. Both pathways highlight the compound's potential to influence CCF-STTG1 through different molecular mechanisms, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the specific interactions and their relevance to the target protein.
